description: Tap by P3 Adaptive answers questions from Power BI models that P3 Adaptive has made public. It lists the public models and what each one holds, reads a model's tables, columns, measures and relationships, and runs one read-only DAX query at a time against the live model through the Power BI executeQueries REST API, so every figure is current when you ask. Each answer names the model it came from. Nobody signs in. The question, the query and its results are not kept, and the caller's address is kept only as a keyed code that changes daily, used for rate limits. Tap is a pilot, so its models and limits can change.

defaultPrompt: Which public data models can you query, and what does each one cover?
What was Northlight Coffee's net revenue by channel in 2025?
Which five Northlight cafes had the most revenue in 2025?
